entries.note: The shipper collects an empty container to load it; the cargo is not yet with KMTC. KMTC's reply gives the code; the wording is the name its tracking page gives the step.
The loaded container enters the terminal at the port of loading. After the container moved, a further gate in is transit.
The loaded container leaves a terminal of the port of loading for another one before it is loaded.
The loaded container reaches an inland depot or freight station after the port; named in the step list of KMTC's tracking page script.
The consignee takes the loaded container from the terminal.
The consignee returns the unloaded container. Before the container moved, it is an empty container returned unused.
